name: Navri Mile Hitlerla
summary: Abhiram, a perfectionist millionaire, unexpectedly finds himself united with Leela, a carefree young woman. She must navigate the challenges of becoming a mother-in-law to his three daughters-in-law.

name: Jaago Mohan Pyare
summary: Jaago Mohan Pyare is a Marathi television series starring Atul Parchure and Supriya Pathare in the lead. The story revolves around Mohan, a middle-class tailor, who is harassed by his dominating wife and mother-in-law. A fairy enters his life to help him with all the difficulties and soon his life takes a magical turn. Find out if his wife gets to know about this fairy or not.

name: Tumm Se Tumm Tak
summary: Anu, a kind 20-year-old, and Aryavardhan, a resolute 46-year-old businessman, defy societal norms and family resistance, overcoming struggles to demonstrate that love transcends age or boundaries.

name: Saru
summary: A Rajasthani kabaddi star relocates to Mumbai, overcoming challenges while pursuing her dreams and helping her mother gain recognition within their family.

name: Vasudha
summary: A happy go-lucky Vasudha joins business leader Chandrika's house as a maid and craves her approval despite their ideological differences. Will she find acceptance in Chandrika's world?

name: Jagriti - Ek Nayi Subah
summary: Jagriti, from the marginalised Chitta community, challenges age-old traditions to empower her people and locks horns with her leader who works for the mafia.

name: Premala Conditions Apply
summary: This series is set inside a mid-scale IT company in Mumbai. The kind of place with a vision statement in the lobby, open-plan seating designed for collaboration that mostly ends up being used to keep a watch on rival teams.

name: Sanai Chaughade
summary: The journey of Sharvari and Jay who adore their families. Despite being contradictory personalities who're at constant loggerheads and hailing from completely different classes of the society, they end up falling in love with each other

name: Mera Balam Thanedaar
summary: The importance of refraining from marrying daughters at a young age and avoiding the perception of them as burdens.

name: The Enid Blyton Adventure Series
summary: Four kids and their pet parrot solve mysteries in exotic places. Based on the novels by Enid Blyton.

name: Love with the Lion
summary: This drama tells an inspirational story of mutual achievement and passionate dedication. Young female bodyguard Su Yuejiao and talented scholar Cheng Qi, from vastly different backgrounds, have different ambitions and styles. Forced together by chance to achieve their respective life ideals, they eventually see each other's strengths and complement each other's weaknesses. Together with the entire Su Family Escort Agency, they bravely overcome difficulties, share hardships, and defy authority, ultimately achieving their ideals and bringing prosperity to the community, thus writing a legendary tale of youthful inspiration.

name: Kaise Mujhe Tum Mil Gaye
summary: A woman with faith in love meets a man cautious about romance due to past heartbreak. Despite their differences, they grow close and must decide if they can overcome their opposing views.

previousepisode.name: Virat and Amruta go on a date

name: Bhutu
summary: The story of a jolly little ghost.

name: Al Ameel
summary: Tasked with infiltrating a notorious mob, a police academy graduate discovers that his long-thought dead brother is part of the very organization he's trying to take down

name: Devmanus
summary: An impostor Devi Singh enters a small village claiming to be Dr Ajit Kumar Dev.He not only extorts money from his patients in name of treatment.But also seduces village beautiful women towards him and later killing them.

name: Devmanus 2
summary: The story continues where villagers have built a statue in memory of their loving Dr Ajit Kumar Dev (Devi Singh) two mark the second anniversary of the day he had arrived in their village.

name: Ratris Khel Chale
summary: Anna Naik passes away on the day of his son's engagement.After his death several unnatural things happen in their house.The family believes that it's spirit of Shevanta who hanged herself outside their house as Anna had betrayed her.

name: Ratris Khel Chale 2
summary: Anna Naik is famous for his casanova image and menacing nature. Shewanta, his mistress, decides to teach him a lesson. Meanwhile, Annas wife, Indu tries to save their family from evil spirits.

name: Ratris Khel Chale 3
summary: In the dead of night, when the spirits arise, will Anna Naik return to expose the inexplicable mysteries and unearth the secrets that will shake the very foundation of his family?

name: Mawlana
summary: Fleeing his past and shunned by his people, Jaber takes on identity of a sacred figure in a remote village awaiting salvation. As faith, power, and manipulation merge, he becomes a beacon of hope and the focus of a perilous moral crisis.

name: Bi Khams Arwah
summary: Called "the dead woman's son," Shams learns he's a tycoon's heir. The inheritance has one condition: locate the four siblings his father erased to secure his legal identity. If he fails, he forfeits both fortune and life.

name: Fire on Fire
summary: Syrian refugee Mariam gets stranded in Beirut, forced to deal with moneylender Omran while developing feelings for Lebanese music teacher Aziz amidst Syrian-Lebanese conflicts.

name: Junoon: Aisi Nafrat, Toh Kaisa Ishq
summary: The journey of the city bred Meera and the rustic and rugged son of the soil Prithvi, two people who were imperfect for each other, and how their burning love story would eventually test every relationship they by hold close.

name: Jagadhatri
summary: A daughter's fight for dignity and an intelligence officer's war for truth, Jagadhatri's dual life embodies strength, sacrifice and the relentless pursuit of justice.

name: Hekayet Narges
summary: "Under the weight of harsh societal judgment, Nargis spirals into lies and crime in a desperate attempt to build a false family that grants her stability-only to face a tragic fate she never expected."

name: Pati Brahmachari
summary: Isha and Suraj' emerge as a perfect pair, having turned their imperfect beginning into a journey of love. As successful IAS officers they work together to bring positive change in their community.

name: Etnen Gherna
summary: A reclusive high school teacher meets a famous actress in crisis, sparking a life-changing connection despite the challenges.

name: Ward Ala Foll Wa Yasmeen
summary: A chance encounter between two people leading very different lives sets off a chain of charming mishaps and surprises. As a heartfelt romance emerges, their love is put to the ultimate test.

name: Dil Dhokha Aur Desire
summary: A boxer's ambitions lead him into a dangerous world where he must protect a businessman's wife. As duty clashes with desire, he faces impossible choices about love, loyalty, and sacrifice.

name: Khamosh Maut.
summary: A perfect husband with a hidden double life. Two women who were betrayed by the same man chose a path with no return. The plan was simple - until silence started speaking back. Is he really dead, or is guilt playing its own game?

name: Taht Sabe' Ard
summary: When the honest officer Mousa discovers that his brother and sister are counterfeiting dollars, he finds himself trapped in a moral dilemma: either let them face the gangs alone or take control of this dirty business himself to protect them.

name: La Torad Wala Tostabdal
summary: A young woman's search for a life-saving donor sets off a chain of coincidences, revealing hidden family conflicts, old secrets, and the tangled relationships connecting everyone around her.

name: Taht El Sen
summary: When a student disappears from an all-girls school, secrets begin to leak out. Whispers of obsession, jealousy, and betrayal echo through the school corridors, and one girl must navigate a labyrinth of lies to uncover the truth.

name: Midterm
summary: The series takes place at an Egyptian university, following a group of Egyptian and Arab students as they navigate academic pressure, emotional struggles, and the search for identity amid the real challenges facing today's youth.

name: Devmanus Madla Adhyay
summary: A murderer on the run assumes the identity of a vanished tailor in Banaras. As he builds a new life as Gopal, his dark past threatens to catch up with him.

name: The Frenchman
summary: Khaled Moshir, a Smart cunning lawyer who manipulates legal loopholes to win cases, valuing the power of the law over absolute justice, not by seeking the truth, but by exploiting legal loopholes and bending them in favor of his clients.

name: Kaser Adem
summary: The series revolves around a powerful figure in the Syrian society called Al-Hakam, who carries out illegal activities, including drug smuggling. All his plans will be revealed by a woman who seeks vengeance for the murder of her husband.

name: Layali Al-Salheya
summary: In a neighborhood called Al-Salheya in Syria, follow Omar's and his family life.

name: Al Khawali
summary: The story of the rebellious young man, "Nassar bin Oraibi," who faces the injustice of the Ottoman soldiers and becomes a fugitive, among an epic struggle between dignity and defending the people of his neighborhood during early 1900s.

name: Ahlam Kabireh
summary: A small damask family with their daily life, hopes, dreams and disappointments.

name: Al-Zeer Salem
summary: A warrior-poet in pre-Islamic Arabia, Udai bin Rabia lived carefree until his brother King Kolaib's murder. Known as Al-Zeer, he led tribe Taghlib in the decades-long Basus war seeking vengeance.

name: Saqr Qoraish
summary: Following the fall of Damascus in 750, The last Umayyad prince arrived in Andalusia and established his rule there.

name: Rabee' Qortoba
summary: The series focuses on the story of Muhammad bin Abu 'Amir, known as Al-Mansur, who came from the Algeciras, seeking knowledge in the city of Cordoba, and his transformation from a Notary to the ruler of Andalusia.

name: Al Hajjaj
summary: This is the biography of Al Hajjaj Bin Youssef AL Thaqafi, the distinguished character whom a lot controversy was raised around him during one of history's most turbulent eras.

name: Chiquititas
summary: The orphans living at the manor known as Rincón de Luz have their tough reality transformed by a sweet-hearted, dedicated young woman.

name: Cebollitas
summary: The lives of a group of young and dreamy boys, attenders of the Cebollitas soccer club, and their rivalry with opposing teams.

name: Chiquititas sin fin
summary:
The story follows Magalí Garcés, a woman who runs an apple company founded by her father. When she gave birth to a baby seven years earlier, her father surrendered the child to an orphanage and lied to her, claiming the baby had died.

Years later, however, she discovers that her child is alive, though she does not know the child's gender or whereabouts. She begins searching for her son or daughter across various orphanages. Meanwhile, an orphanage run by a cruel matron receives a donation from Magalí, unbeknownst to her, she has given the funds to the very place where her child is living.

name: Al-Khawaga Abdul-Qader
summary: Herbert Doperfield is desperate after his brother death during the World War II, he regains hope again when he goes to Sudan and embraces Islam. He then moves to Upper Egypt and falls in love with a girl from the the notables there.

name: Ish Hashuv Meod
summary: Yehuda Levy, a famous actor and revered fear mature 35-year-old, suffers from panic attacks, binge eating and mood swings after a difficult separation. It meets the latest candidate to be a girl his wife and the two formed a special bond

name: Alıkara
summary:
Two lives that seemed destined never to cross become bound together far more deeply than one could imagine. She is a psychologist accustomed to unraveling the feelings and hidden motives of others; he is a police commissioner used to relying on facts rather than emotions.

Their relationship evolves into a complex game where intimacy gives way to estrangement and trust to doubt, and where a new secret may lie hidden behind every revelation. The past refuses to let go, their feelings intensify, and conflicting forces compel them to make difficult choices time and again.

This is a story about the attraction between two strong personalities—a tale of inner conflicts, secrets, and emotions capable of altering the course of their lives.

name: RuPaul's Drag Race UK All Stars
summary: RuPaul's Drag Race UK: All Stars, celebrating the artistry of the Queens who have worked the U.K. runway.

name: Fala-me de Amor
summary: Four women, childhood friends. Accomplices and confidants.

name: Ninguém Como Tu
summary: The plot follows the unbridled ambition of social climber Luiza Albuquerque and reaches its climax with the start of a great mystery.

name: Tempo de Viver
summary: Fatima, a hardworking supermarket worker, sacrifices her freedom to protect her greedy daughter Maria from a drug trafficking scheme, ultimately questioning if Maria views her as a monster.

name: Things We Never Got Over
summary: When runaway bride Naomi Witt arrives in the quirky town of Knockemout, Virginia, she expects to rescue her estranged twin and return to the life she left behind. Instead, her sister disappears, leaving Naomi with a niece she never knew existed, a town full of irresistible characters — including charming local sheriff Nash Morgan and his decidedly grumpy but infuriatingly sexy brother Knox Morgan — and a future she never imagined.

name: Maria Esperança
summary: A young street vendor struggling to support her dysfunctional family finds her life upended after agreeing to marry a wealthy, terminally ill man to thwart his greedy relatives. Inheriting his vast fortune, she becomes the target of a vengeful aunt-in-law while navigating a tumultuous romance with the deceased man's handsome nephew.

name: Patrulha Salvadora
summary: Equipped with unique superpowers, a group of brave child detectives operating out of a secret underground headquarters must work together to solve mysterious crimes, protect their city, and save missing children from villainous threats.

previousepisode.name: O Caso do Exército do Faraó - Parte 2

name: María Mercedes
summary: María Mercedes, a poor girl who sells lottery tickets, meets a rich man who hates his own family and sees in María Mercedes an opportunity to make their lives miserable.

name: Chiquititas
summary: The orphans living at the manor known as Raio de Luz have their reality transformed by a sweet-hearted, dedicated young woman.

name: Beng Kully
summary: Dr. Doaa defies her father by taking a job as an anesthesiologist at a hospital. Amidst professional challenges, a patient blurts out a dangerous secret while waking up from general anesthesia, sparking a quest for the truth that unites her with her sworn enemy.

name: Chiquititas
summary: The orphans living at the manor known as Raio de Luz have their tough reality transformed by a sweet-hearted, dedicated young woman.

name: Carrossel
summary: The adventures of a group of schoolchildren, taught and guided by a sweet-hearted, careful teacher.

name: Family Business
summary:
Marky runs Brooker & Son, a family building and renovation business, and is passionate about maintaining the "perfect family life".

But, despite the intimacy and banter of three generations of Brookers living under one roof, we see the cracks beginning to appear beneath the surface.

Marky may be a successful family builder, and great at improving other people's lives, but his domestic situation is in need of a little more care and attention.

Despite winning a place at Oxford, his son disappears before his first term and his daughter is suffering from an identity crisis.

Marky - more than anyone - should know that you can't paper over the cracks forever.

name: Carrusel de las Américas
summary: Miss Jimena Fernandez is a second grade teacher and she loves her students so much and her students love her back.

name: El Metr Sameer
summary: "Samir Abu El-Wafa fixes others' family conflicts with wit and sarcasm, but struggles with his own fractured life while on the run from the authorities and his past."

name: El Set Monaliza
summary: The story of a divorced woman facing major life changes after a failed marriage, confronting the effects of separation, rebuilding herself, and finding new love in a challenging society.

name: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
summary:
What happens in Vegas usually stays in Vegas, but behind the flashing lights and million-dollar jackpots is a world visitors have never seen before. For the first time, Discovery pulls back the curtain on the legendary Golden Nugget, one of Las Vegas' most iconic casinos, to follow the larger-than-life personalities responsible for managing demanding high rollers, millions of dollars, and nonstop drama every day. 

Just off the chaos of busy Fremont Street, cameras capture the real-life and often shocking moments that unfold around the clock: unruly guests, high-pressure special events and the relentless efforts required to keep thousands of people safe and entertained each day. Whether it's breaking up a late-night club brawl, responding to an embarrassing medical emergency or racing to move sharks from a 200,000-gallon shark tank, the staff must be ready for whatever Vegas throws their way.

previousepisode.name: The Good, the Bad and the Unlucky

name: Salah Al-deen Al-Ayyobi
summary: A Syrian series about the crusades and the Muslim leader Saladin and his conquest of Jerusalem.

name: Mulouk Al-Tawa'ef
summary: The series talks about the struggle of the Arab kingdoms in Andalusia.

name: Al-Taghriba Al-Filistinia
summary: Abu Ahmad and his family are forced to leave the city of Haifa to find a safe shelter during the 1948 Arab-Israeli war. However, they face tragic conditions and struggle with displacement.

name: El Qessa El Kamla
summary: Inspired by true crimes that shook Egypt, this anthology series explores the country's most notorious criminal cases. Each three-episode arc explores a new crime through a new cast and a distinct creative lens.

name: The Golden Life
summary: Bound by decades of shared history, fallouts and friendship, this fan-favorite group of New Yorkers are starting fresh together in the Sunshine State.

name: Adam's Family: 25 Jaar Later
summary:
A quarter-century after the original reality series introduced Dutch audiences to podcaster/former VJ Adam Curry, singer Patricia Paay, and their family life, this follow-up shifts focus to their daughter, Christina Curry.

The series captures Christina undergoing a major life milestone as she prepares for motherhood. It documents her pregnancy journey, physical challenges, personal dynamics, and preparations for childbirth while navigating her family legacy.

name: Bi Al Haram
summary: When tragedy strikes her traveling theatre troupe, Joud must face a scarred past and an unjust present—where loss, justice, and hope collide as she uncovers a truth more perilous than imagined.

name: Mamá campanita
summary: Carmen is a poor but sweet and honest woman who meets Gerardo, a former student of her late husband, at his funeral. After becoming a widow, Carmen goes to live with her mother, Ana, a mean and selfish woman. Days later, she meets Gerardo again, and love blossoms between them.

name: Señorita maestra
summary: The story follows a group of sixth-grade students and their teacher, Jacinta Pichimahuida , at the Escuela Nacional de Buenos Aires, located in the capital city.

name: Jacinta Pichimauida, la maestra que no se olvida
summary: Jacinta Pichimahuida, a beloved elementary school teacher, joins her mischievous but charming students through their lively pranks.

name: Al Batal
summary: After risking his life to pull a teenager from the clutches of a fatal fire, a middle-aged man becomes a local hero - only to find himself amidst an inevitable power battle against a cunning thug.

name: Bi Al Dam
summary: After 45 years, Ghalya, discovers a dark secret about her family and birth-a revelation that makes her determined to seek a mysterious truth about who she really is

name: Lel Maout
summary: Fed up with his mysterious and inexplicable wife, Hadi's business trip turns his life around when he meets a spontaneous and special woman.

name: Kawalis Al Madina
summary: Colonel Anwar, with the help of journalist Ola, is trying to hunt down a large network of corruption in Lebanon, as Rana works in smuggling money with a Jordanian prince and a senior officer covers up for a drug kingpin.

name: Fire Me...Please
summary: Two contestants start new entry-level jobs on the exact same morning, with a single, bizarre objective: get fired as close to 3:00 p.m. as possible without directly asking to be terminated, breaking laws, or breaking character.

previousepisode.name: Did You Just Pick Something Off the Pizza?

name: The Heiress Strikes Back
summary: As a child, He Mei, the daughter of Rongcheng's wealthiest family, falls victim to a ruthless scheme orchestrated by the family nanny, Zhang Xin. Her mother dies in a fire, her adopted brother He Shi prevents her from escaping, and the family butler eventually abducts and sells her to a remote mountain village. Years later, He Mei returns under the name Li Zhangxin, only to discover that Zhang Xin has taken her mother's place as the mistress of the He family. He Shi has become a reckless spendthrift, while the butler now serves as Zhang Xin's loyal accomplice. Determined to reclaim her identity and uncover the truth, Li Zhangxin infiltrates the household as a nanny. She rescues her pregnant sister-in-law, Shu Roujing, from domestic abuse and cares for He Yu, who has been left unconscious after a car accident. When He Yu wakes up, he grows suspicious of her, forcing Li Zhangxin to claim that she entered the He family because she is in love with him. Through constant suspicion and confrontation, the two gradually develop genuine feelings for each other. When the patriarch of the He family returns, Li Zhangxin finally proves her true identity. He Yu also discovers that Zhang Xin and He Shi were behind his car accident and joins Li Zhangxin in seeking revenge. Together, they carefully set their plans in motion, exposing the pair's darkest secrets and turning them against each other. But just as Li Zhangxin finally reclaims her rightful place as the He family heiress, she discovers that the true mastermind behind everything has only just emerged.

name: O Arquiteto
summary: Tomé leads a double life of success and secret filmed encounters. His mistress Carolina and his secretary Elsa unite to expose him before his mall project launch, each with different motives for revenge.

name: Rina
summary:
Rina is a poor young hunchback woman who sells paper flowers and straw dolls at traffic lights in Mexico City to support her sick father and siblings.

An eccentric, wealthy old man named Don Leopoldo meets Rina. Despising his greedy family, he manipulates Rina into marrying him purely to ensure his fortune passes to her rather than his sister-in-law, Doña Rafaela.

Leopoldo dies shortly after the marriage, leaving Rina a massive fortune and estate. Doña Rafaela plots ruthlessly to manipulate Rina and strip her of the inheritance. Complications peak when Rina falls in love with Rafaela's handsome son, Carlos Augusto.

name: Aard W Talab
summary: The series follows intersecting lives under pressure, led by Heba, a schoolteacher who struggles to support her family, care for her brother with disabilities, and save her sick mother.

name: Taj
summary: In a dramatic tale, boxer Taj clings to his patriotic principles, risking alienation and loss from those around him. Despite challenges, he refuses to abandon the core values and ethics instilled in him, embodying resilience and integrity.

name: Ward w Shokolata
summary: Marwa, a bold TV host, falls for a powerful lawyer with a dark past, sparking a storm of love, secrets, and betrayal.

name: We Nensa Elly Kan
summary: Under the spotlight of fame, star Jalila is caught in a web of mysterious threats. Badr, a retired fighter, becomes her bodyguard, facing dangers that test his skills and heart, as protecting love is harder than protecting life.

name: Wa Teqabel Habib
summary: After learning that her wealthy husband has betrayed her and secretly married another woman, she leaves him and sets out in search of a new love.

name: W Nheb Tani Leh
summary: Ghalia's unfaithfulness in love and relationships after her divorce comes to question when she suddenly meets a handsome young man named Murad raising the question "Why Do We Love Again?"

name: Sawa Sawa
summary: At the heart of a humble neighbourhood, an extraordinary love between Ahlam and Ibrahim blooms amid external obstacles and the intrusion of an obsessive man, wrapped in a pulse-pounding and romantic ambience.

name: Al Khawaat
summary: Three Sisters are kicked out by their father after their mother dies. When they grow up, they face several challenges in work, love, and marriage, and to make matters worse, their father dies, so they have to deal with new obstacles.

name: Jacinta Pichimahuida, la maestra que no se olvida
summary: The character originated in short stories written by Abel Santa Cruz in the 1940s for the magazine Patoruzú. After an earlier radio adaptation, Canal 9 brought the concept to television in 1966, starring Evangelina Salazar as the sweet, patient primary school teacher whose gentle pedagogical methods contrast with strict traditional schooling.

name: Lakshmi Niwas
summary: Lakshmi, a resilient woman, navigates the complexities of a traditional joint family while supporting her husband Shriniwas' dream of building their own home.

name: Mittendrin - Flughafen Frankfurt
summary: Behind the scenes of Germany's largest aviation hub, this observational docuseries follows the pilots, mechanics, customs officers, and ground crews who battle tight turnarounds, weather chaos, and high-stakes logistics to keep Frankfurt Airport moving.

name: Guerrieri: La regola dell'equilibrio
summary: Brilliant, empathetic, yet deeply troubled defense attorney Guido Guerrieri navigates the sunlit streets and dark underbelly of Bari, taking on seemingly hopeless cases—including defending an esteemed judge and lifelong friend accused of corruption—while struggling to balance his own fractured personal life.

name: Notre Dame Football on NBC
summary: In American sports television's longest-running exclusive single-school media partnership, NBC Sports captures the pride, tradition, and home-field drama of the independent Fighting Irish live from iconic Notre Dame Stadium.

previousepisode.name: Michigan State Spartans at Notre Dame Fighting Irish

nextepisode.name: Stanford Cardinal at Notre Dame Fighting Irish

name: This Much is True Crime
summary: Join Britain's leading criminologist, Professor David Wilson, and journalist and TV producer Martin Frizell as they examine the cases everyone is talking about.

name: Black Island Prison
summary: To solve a border missing persons case, Lian Ming, a detective from Lingdong, also infiltrates Black Island Prison undercover. Wen Bang, a former special forces operative from Nanling, is compelled to enter the prison and serve his sentence in order to rescue Yachun and her daughter, who depend on him as much as he depends on them. Behind bars, the two move from mutual hostility to mutual support. As they join forces against the gangs, they must also outwit the mounting crises their true identities create. Even as they slowly expose the prison's criminal truth, a far greater threat is closing in...

name: En Coma
summary:
En Coma centers around a young woman named Anabel who survives a devastating explosion but is left trapped in a deep, unresponsive coma.

While she is completely paralyzed in her hospital bed, corrupt individuals target her body to illegally harvest and sell her heart for $500,000.

A male nurse named Rafael has a supernatural gift—he can hear the spirits of the dead and the subconscious minds of people stuck between life and death. Anabel's consciousness manages to reach out to Rafael, pleading for his help. He must find a way to protect her body and keep her alive before her enemies can find and kill her.

name: My Adventures in Television
summary: A struggling TV network hires a young theatrical producer to improve their programming, but he finds that it is a hotbed of incompetence and jealous backstabbing.

name: The Missing Piece
summary:
After an accident leaves Shen Mo with amnesia, he mistakes Ji Mingxuan, the man who saved him, for his lover. But when Shen Mo regains his memories, the six months they spent loving each other become completely erased. Desperate to keep Shen Mo by his side, Ji Mingxuan proposes a three-year ""contract lover"" arrangement. When two people are already in love, can a contract still keep their hearts in check?

Adapted from a popular Jinjiang Literature City novel! A heartbreaking romance meets contract lovers in a love story that is as sweet as it is painfully addictive.

name: New Boyfriend
summary: A story about the love and relationships of people in an office, a place that is not only a workplace but also a place where someone's feelings are made clear.

name: Echoes Through Ink
summary: Actress Xia Yi Mo unexpectedly lands a role in the historical drama "The Scent of Ink" - the very one she was originally cast in. Hoping to play the lead, she instead finds herself portraying a maid, a guard, and a stepmother. She has only five chances to play this role, and to return to reality, she must save Xue Ruo Wan - the main character played by her former best friend. When she finally transforms into the villainous supporting character Xue Ke Ying - the one she fears most - the familiar plot gradually spirals out of control: her relationship with her sister shifts from hostile to one of life-or-death stakes, and her relationship with the cold-hearted General Ning Yuan Ci evolves from mutual trials to genuine affection. Behind the life-threatening crisis lies a conspiracy orchestrated through marriage. Will she be able to escape her predetermined fate and rewrite the ending for herself and her loved ones?

name: A Trap Called Desire
summary: Falsely accused, Go Eun Seol loses everything overnight. Instead of running, she hunts—unraveling a conspiracy built on greed and lies until the ‘perfect' cover‑up begins to collapse under the one woman it failed to erase.

name: Brandweer 010
summary: Sirens. Smoke. Fire. Life-saving decisions when every second counts. In a raw and unscripted look behind the uniform, cameras follow the first responders of the Rotterdam-Rijnmond fire brigade as career professionals and volunteers risk everything to navigate high-stakes emergencies, intense high-pressure rescues, and the personal toll of life on the front lines.

name: City Rong
summary: When Lian Ye, hall master of the Sanshan Gang, loses his whole family in a massacre, he teams up with childhood friend Li Mingyuan, deputy police chief of Rongcheng, and Chen Dieyi, proprietress of the Huamoli Cabaret, to investigate and avenge. They uncover a web of eerie cases spun by Japanese spy mastermind Matsui Jiiichiro to penetrate Rongcheng, battling the invaders and putting their lives on the line to protect their country.

name: The Four Seasons
summary: The Four Seasons sitcom follows four couples as they spend four holidays together over the course of the four seasons.

name: The Table
summary: Two people sitting across a table, hiding feelings they've never dared to confess.

name: Eyes on You
summary: Archery champion Lee Junhyeong reunites with his first love Ahn Siwoo, who was forced to leave six years ago for his sake. He intends to vent his resentment through torment, but when he learns the truth behind his departure, he is overwhelmed with regret and spares no effort to win him back.

name: Love Hurts
summary: Do Jin received the worst grades in his class, so his teacher had him to study with Jae Won. Although neither high school student was thrilled about the situation, they gradually came to enjoy each other's company. Eventually, however, they lost touch, yet Do Jin could not forget Jae Won, who had become his first love.

name: Freshman Diaries
summary: Freshman Diaries is a 10-part documentary series that follows a diverse group of first-year students at the University of Texas at Austin as they make their way from orientation through finals.

name: Private Lesson
summary: College freshman Jae On has harbored a secret crush on his former tutor, Hyeon Seo, for three long years. When Hyeon Seo finally tries to move on from his own painful, unrequited love, Jae On seizes the opportunity to boldly confess his feelings. Terrified that the younger man will suffer the same heartbreak he did, Hyeon Seo desperately pushes him away, but Jae On's relentless and passionate pursuit begins to slowly dismantle his guarded heart.

name: Make Me Tremble
summary: Depicts the story of Yeon Su, a woman raised in a conservative household who works at a marketing company and has lived her life while maintaining her chastity, as she meets a man who is the CEO of an adult product company. As their worlds collide, they challenge each other's beliefs and grow together in unexpected ways.

name: A Certain Dark Side's Item
summary:
A massive "academy city" located in western Tokyo.

In this city, with a total population of 2.3 million, approximately 80% of whom are students, a special curriculum for developing psychic abilities is implemented, and the students' abilities are evaluated on a six-level scale from "Level 0" to "Level 5".

Boasting scientific and technological advancements far surpassing common sense, this dreamlike educational institution provides everyone with scientific abilities and allows them to live in peace—but behind this tranquility lies a "dark side" organization that undertakes dirty work that is never revealed to the public.

"ITEM" - an elite unit composed of four girls.

Kinuhata Saiai, who can freely manipulate nitrogen to provide an impenetrable defense.
Frenda Seivelun, who uses explosives and traps to toy with the battlefield .
Takitsubo Rikou, who can read and track the faint powers emitted by ability users.
And Mugino Shizuri, one of only seven "Level 5" in Academy City. 
Then, a fifth girl appears before them.
Their encounter with her leads the "items" into a new darkness.

This is a story depicting the daily lives, bonds, and deep, profound darkness of girls with rather unusual abilities, steeped in violence, cruelty, and depravity.

name: Gemma Collins: Everything. All at Once
summary:
Gemma Collins: Everything. All At Once is a raw, relatable and deeply human portrait of a woman navigating love, family, fertility, grief and the pressures of life in the public eye as she tries to keep moving forward while everything around her is changing. Sometimes, everything really does happen all at once.

With extraordinary access to Gemma behind closed doors, this series reveals a side of her rarely seen before. She allows the cameras into the moments when the bravado drops; when she is vulnerable, exhausted, hopeful and trying to make sense of everything happening around her. And amongst the challenge of trying to keep everything together, Gemma meets life head-on, with the honesty and humour that have made her such a uniquely recognisable figure.

name: Bad Kid Good Partner
summary: Top star Yu Il and an unknown actor Hye Seong are forced to play a fake couple after a scandal.

name: Professeur Raoult vs le gang des Cerises
summary: 2020. The Covid-19 pandemic strikes the world. In Marseille, Professor Didier Raoult claims to have found a miracle cure: hydroxychloroquine. Within weeks, the scientist becomes a star in France and a global phenomenon. But six ordinary people—teachers, researchers, and healthcare workers—decide to verify his claims. Banding together on social media under the name "Cerises Trottinettes," they embark on an investigation they were never meant to undertake. Amidst a battle fueled by a cult of personality, disinformation, and death threats, their quest for truth turns into a brutal standoff.

name: Ali Baba aur 40 Bhoot
summary: Rooted in logic and science, Alisha is drawn into an experience that defies everything she believes. Will she find answers or uncover a terrifying truth?

name: Raised by Demons: Panda Li
summary: The story follows Li Xiongmao, a human boy raised by the demon race, who is ordered by his master to leave the Black and White Mountain to kill three enemies who destroyed the demon race. In the process of investigating the truth, he gradually uncovers the story of the conflict between humans and demons, the secrets of the dynasty, and the mystery of his own destiny.

name: Funny Face
summary: A naive college student from small-town Illinois moves to Los Angeles to attend UCLA and navigates big-city life while working part-time as an actress in TV commercials.

name: Mission: Mompossible
summary: A story that unfolds as the male and female leads from two families become entangled: one family has a mother who, facing death, is called "crazy" for the lengths she goes to for the children she will leave behind, and the other has a "crazy mom" who, driven solely by her own desires and greed, abandons and turns her back even on the daughter she gave birth to.

name: Proxy Driver
summary: Jae-hoon is a timid man who works as a designated driver to make ends meet after being unfairly fired. When he becomes the target of violent exploitation by Jun-hyuk, a drunken team leader at a major corporation, he finds himself trapped in an abnormal relationship marred by power and emotional dependence. Within this toxic cycle, Jae-hoon struggles to reclaim his lost dignity and humanity.

name: Bankzitters: Overleven in Het Wild
summary: The five members of the Bankzitters are stripped of their everyday luxuries, smartphones, and comforts, and left in an isolated wilderness environment. Working together—or against each other—they must complete physical challenges, forage/cook food, build shelter, and survive outdoors while bringing their signature humor to the extreme situation.

name: The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom
summary: The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom follow the sons of Baribara, a diplomatic general from the peaceful Marronnier Kingdom, as they travel to seven neighboring nations as knights to build alliances and prevent war through diplomacy.

name: Ka Ina
summary: Two women are dangerously related by superstition, magic, and one man's love. Catalina Miranda and Maniña Yerichana, both are young and beautiful. The first an assertive, independent and cosmopolitan engineer; she educated in Europe and works for a transnational company in Germany; the second is the most powerful and fearsome woman in the jungle: a priestess daughter of an indigenous Yanomami princess and an adventurous Dutch gold digger, who was abandoned at birth and raised by a herd of jaguars until the age of one year was found by a Yanomami shaman who raised her.

name: Maria Mercedes
summary: The story of Maria Mercedes begins on a cacao farm in Davao, where as a small girl Mercedes was left to fend for herself and her siblings when their mother abandons them after their father's untimely death. Moving to Manila for work, Mercedes meets Clavio, a friend who harbors feelings for her, and Luis, the man who will teach her how to love. Fate has a few surprises for Mercedes: another man comes into her life offering her genuine love and a life of abundance she has never experienced before. But what if this man is also the key to the truth that will tear her family apart? What if the promise of a better future is the same thing that will ruin her life? Will Mercedes become like her mother, who turned her back on her family, or will she be a stronger woman who will defend her loved ones to the end? Will love be able to heal the wounds created by a bitter past?

name: Rincón de luz
summary: A man builds up an orphanage out of a scheme to come into an inheritance, but gradually grows genuinely fond of the children sheltered there.

name: George Burns Comedy Week
summary: George Burns Comedy Week is a comedy anthology television series broadcast in the United States by CBS as part of its 1985 fall lineup, hosted by George Burns.

name: As Aventuras de Poliana
summary: Poliana is a kind girl of 11 years old who has seen his world collapse after his mother's death. She's going to live with her aunt Luisa, a rich and severe woman. Having to face all the dilemmas of a new life in the big city, which she never imagined existed, Poliana decides to apply the "glad game", taught by her parents, which consists of having a positive view of everything, even in times of difficulty.

name: Poliana Moça
summary: Poliana is now a girl and will be 15 years old and this event caused a lot of problems even when the party ended now is another reason João or eric who is going to date Poliana?

name: A Infância de Romeu e Julieta
summary: Two families with different proposals live in discord, as they want to transform the Castanheiras neighborhood either into buildings or into a village. Between fights, Romeo and Juliet know each other and from then on, the families

name: Carinha de Anjo
summary: Dulce Maria is a sweet, naive, inteligent and happy 5 year old girl. She is playful, adventurous and extremely curious.

name: ¡Vivan los niños!
summary: Follows the primary school called "Patria Unida", its teachers (among those young and pretty Lupita), students and their parents.

name: Amy, la niña de la mochila azul
summary: The story of a sweet-hearted tomboy who lives at the shore with her fisherman father, her adventurous friends and a mysterious mermaid.

name: Tempo de Viver
summary: An obsessed, possessive man will stop at nothing to eliminate anyone who comes close to the woman he loves, spiraling into violence as he tries to keep her under his control.

name: Serafín
summary: After getting into trouble in Heaven, a mischievous angel named Serafín is sent to Earth as a guardian angel to earn his wings. In Mexico City, he joins forces with an unhappy young boy named Pepe and a group of animated household items to bring joy to Pepe's home while defending innocence and love from Lucio, an agent of darkness.

name: Al Haram
summary: Al Haram series tells the story of Laura and her husband Adam who is the ex fiance of her friend Alice and highlights a past of secret affairs, love of money and complex relationships.

name: Chiquititas, la historia
summary: The earlier years of the Rincón de Luz orphans as told by its original intern, Mili.

name: Chiquititas
summary: Martín returns to Mexico to help cure his sister Gaby. He meets Belén, with whom he falls in love. Martín ends up taking charge of an orphanage, where he, together with Belén and the children, will experience endless stories and adventures

name: Todo por tu amor
summary: 'Todo por tu amor' tells the story of Marina Rangel, a young, enterprising, and courageous woman who struggles to support her family through her work as a physiotherapist in a public hospital. There she meets the wealthy and handsome Dr. Samuel Montalván, and from then on, her real problems begin. A deep and passionate love blossoms between Marina and Samuel. But this relationship has no future: many surprising events and terrible coincidences conspire to keep Marina and Samuel apart.

name: Segn El Nessa
summary: Three women who faced numerous challenges in their lives, endured injustice, and consequently committed various crimes, find themselves in prison. This marks the beginning of a new phase in their lives that diverges from what they used to know, especially after the outbreak of the January 25th Revolution, which brings about a change in the country's situation.

name: Como tú, ninguna
summary: Gilda Barreto is a humble and kind-hearted young woman, raised by Asunción after being abandoned by her real mother (Cecilia). She fulfills her life's greatest dream by marrying Raymundo Landaeta, a young man from high society, but suffers day after day from the persistent evil of Leónidas de Landaeta, Raymundo's mother.

name: Quirpa de tres mujeres
summary: Gonzalo Landaeta was a rich landowner who suffered a terrible betrayal from Vicente Echeverría who stole his land and his wife thereby making him die in sorrow. His three beautiful daughters Manuela, Emiliana and Camila, are filled with a strong passion that Vicente, who has raised them with a firm hand, will ensure that it ends.

name: A Tale of the Secret Saint
summary: Fia always dreamed of becoming a knight. Born into a family of knights, she's the least talented among them, but she still clutches to her hope and trains with everything she has. When the day comes for her to slay a small demon and prove her worth, she ends up face to face with a dragon instead! A deadly injury makes her life flash before her eyes…and she suddenly remembers her former life, when she was a powerful Saint in a bygone era who defeated the Demon King. That life ended in pain because of who she was, making her fear ever becoming a Saint again. Now that the magic from her previous life has been rekindled, she may become a more powerful knight than she ever dreamed–if only she can survive long enough!

name: Magic Repo Man: Dumped by My Party, I'll Cash In With a Cute Support Fairy to Become the Strongest!
summary: If there's one thing you can never have enough of in a world of RPG-style swords and sorcery, it's magic points! Whether you're fueling spells, techniques, or showing off an incredible ability, you've gotta spend those points to do real damage. But what if you run out? Lent is part of the up-and-coming party known as the "Skypiercers," and thanks to his unique Gift, he can loan massive amounts of magic to others. No MP? No problem with Lent around! Except, now that his companions have become formidable heroes (thanks to his skill), his usefulness is questioned. Kicked out of the group, Lent is furious…until he discovers a hidden power to his Gift. Now, with his adorably devious fairy partner, he's going to claw back every last scrap of magic from his former party—with interest!

name: Papai Coração
summary: After the death of wife Laura, Mário tries to start his life over with his daughter, little Titina. While he begins a romance with Paula, Titina has imaginary conversations with her deceased mother and plays the biggest pranks at school.

name: Diablo
summary: After decades of bringing entire universes to life through our games, we're partnering with some creative powerhouses to tell even more stories beyond gaming across new screens. A new animated series set in the world of ‘Diablo' is in development with Netflix. More details will be shared in the future, but this is only the beginning, with even more taking shape across our universes.

name: Papá corazón
summary: Pinina is a young girl who lost her mother. Her only relatives are her father and an aunt ; both love her dearly, but they don't have much time to care for her. Pinina spends much of her time at a boarding school where she experiences numerous adventures. This allows her to fill the void left by her mother's absence with the nuns, who help her through difficult times. As the story unfolds, she discovers new things and opens her heart to her father.

name: Mundo de juguete
summary: Cristina is Mariano's daughter, a widower. She attends a Catholic school and creates a world of her own ("mundo de juguete") in the school garden. At school she meets "Nana Tomasina", an old woman who lives behind the boarding school where Cristina attends. She takes the lonely girl in and advises her. Cristina succeeds in making her father marry Rosario who was a novice at the convent/boarding school so that she can have a new mother.

name: Un mundo de muñeca
summary: After losing her mother, a mischievous seven-year-old girl at a strict Catholic school seeks comfort in a secret attic where she talks to her mother's memory, while constantly pulling antics to help her grieving father find love again.

name: Hilary
summary: After accepting an unexpected job offer from celebrity chef Yvonne Durand, Hilary Banks impulsively moves to New York determined to prove herself beyond her Bel-Air connections — only to find that success, friendship and love in the city come with a cost she never anticipated.

name: Before I Let Go
summary: Before I Let Go follows Yasmen and Josiah Wade. Their love was supposed to last forever, but when life dealt them back-to-back devastating blows, they realized love can't solve everything. The life they created fell apart — divorce and shared custody followed. Now, Yasmen is finally starting to find joy, but proximity to Josiah keeps the embers hot despite reopening old wounds. They are beginning to wonder if they're truly ready to let go of everything they once had. Is it too late to find forever? Or could the second time around be even better?

name: The Traitors Srbija
summary: Follows contestants in a psychological reality competition where hidden Traitors eliminate Faithful players, who must expose the Traitors to win the prize money.

name: Raising Poison, Raising Love
summary: Ten years ago the capital's worst rake, Xiao Jingyu, was tamed by a mysterious girl wielding a whip and sorcery, and swore at parting to marry her. Now a grand general, he hides his rank and slips into Taohua Village as a live-in son-in-law—all to find that girl again.

name: Tres mujeres
summary: Three sisters fight for love and independence under the tyrannical thumb of their iron-fisted grandmother, "La Generala," who rules their rural hacienda and dictates every aspect of their personal lives.

name: Corazón Apasionado
summary: The saga of love between Patricia Campos Miranda, the granddaughter of a rich uncompromising farmer, and Armando Marcano, the poor foreman of the farm of Patricia's grandmother.

name: It's You, Regardless
summary: An unprecedented, unpredictable, and audacious romance that begins 'out of the blue' when a 'melodrama master' actor with a fatal flaw meets a suspicious woman who believes she is the heroine of a drama.

name: The Mob
summary:
The reality competition, hosted by Parker Posey, follows a group of celebrities in a lavish Italian villa as they shake down, hustle, and whack their way to win up to $250,000.

Every episode, they will tackle mob movie-inspired jobs to survive. But every mob family needs a don, and whoever they choose will have absolute power — deciding who makes money, who stays, and who ultimately gets whacked.

name: Мій новий берег
summary:
At 25, Galina has already become the city pole dancing champion. She works in a men's club, but is not at all ready to put up with the behavior of some visitors. Galya stands up for the dancers when clients cross the line. Because of her principled nature, Galya constantly conflicts with management, receives fines, and is increasingly in debt. It seems that getting out of this circle of problems will not be easy.
Everything changes when Galya learns about the death of her own aunt. The woman leaves her a house with a land plot in the small seaside town of Lazurny Port. Galya goes there for the funeral and soon becomes the heiress.
She decides not to return to her previous problems, but to use the house and land for her own business. Galya dreams of opening a hotel in Lazurny Port and building a successful business there. The new property becomes a chance for the girl to change her life.

name: Las tres caras de Malvina
summary: A versatile woman navigates three distinct, chaotic lives alongside her well-meaning but hopelessly clumsy partner. Surrounded by eccentric relatives and meddling neighbors, the couple stumbles through endless domestic misunderstandings and schemes that repeatedly backfire, relying on quick wit to fix the mess every time.

name: Hollow Cross
summary:
Nakahara Michimasa, who used to work at an advertising agency and now runs a pet funeral business that he inherited from his uncle. Eleven years ago, a life-changing incident led to his divorce from his wife, and he is still unable to come to terms with the grief of the past, spending his days in loneliness and emptiness.

One day, a detective who had handled the investigation in Nakahara's past case visits him and tells him that Nakahara's ex-wife has been murdered on the street. The culprit is quickly arrested, but there are many inexplicable points in his testimony. Nakahara retraces his ex-wife's steps since their separation in order to uncover the truth behind her death. This also means confronting the grief he had once turned away from. Eventually, another crime, far removed from the incident 11 years ago, begins to emerge...

Nishina Fumiya, a doctor who works in pediatrics at Keimei University Hospital. He is dedicated to his work and highly trusted by his patients. At home, he is a loving husband who cherishes his wife and son. One day, Fumiya receives news that his wife's father has killed a woman on the street for money. Now a member of the perpetrator's family, Fumiya, despite facing slander and abuse from those around him, defends his wife and offers to apologize to the victim's family, the Nakaharas, on behalf of the perpetrator's family. Despite being in a position to distance himself from the incident, why does Fumiya choose to stand at the forefront...?

name: A Suitable Match
summary: To escape an unwanted family arrangement, a sharp-witted career woman enters a contract marriage with a high-powered executive—unaware that her new "husband" has secretly orchestrated the entire match to win her heart.

name: There Is Also a Hole in the Student Organization!
summary:
Ume Mizunoe, a first-year student at the prestigious Fujinari Academy, excels in Japanese literature but struggles so badly in science that his chances of advancing are at risk. Hoping to boost his academic record, he joins the student council—only to find himself surrounded by a cast of quirky characters: a charismatic yet secretly shy president, a kind but intimidating treasurer, an adorably cheeky boy, and a tiny, stray-cat-like secretary.

Thrown into a whirlwind of chaotic daily life, Ume's school days are about to get a lot more unpredictable—and a lot more lively!

name: Undercover Lover
summary: 14 seemingly single men and women arrive at a stunning villa, but 5 are secretly in relationships. From a second villa, their partners watch as they try to keep their romance hidden. When sparks fly from the start, jealousy and distrust quickly create tension.

name: I Hunt Wraiths in Mortal Realm
As Promised
summary: He Xiaoyuan, an ordinary palace maid, has been trapped in a cycle of rebirth for thirty-three lifetimes. In every life, she does everything she can to win the heart of Crown Prince Zhao Junyao, only for him to fall for the courtesan Mu Tingting and for her life to end in a palace coup. In her thirty-fourth life, Seventh Prince Zhao Baiqing reveals that their fates are bound together. The cycle can only be broken if he ascends the throne and He Xiaoyuan wins the Crown Prince's true love. To achieve their shared goal, the two form an alliance, with Zhao Baiqing personally coaching He Xiaoyuan on how to capture the Crown Prince's heart. But as fate draws them ever closer, they gradually discover their feelings for each other. In the end, they join forces to unravel the conspiracy, break free from the cycle, and find true love.

name: A Secret in Prague
summary: The series follows Mikoy, an ordinary guy who falls for a mafia boss' daughter, forcing him to choose between protecting his own family or betraying the woman he loves.

name: Potje Rijden: Kirgizië
summary: Sean and Stefan go head-to-head in a race across the harsh and unforgiving landscapes of Kyrgyzstan. The race kicks off, and both teams discover the cultural differences between themselves and the locals of Kyrgyzstan.

name: Frank's Veiling: Influencers Onder De Hamer
summary: Frank van der Slot welcomes influencers to his reverse auction. He offers hilarious and merciless challenges where participants don't spend money, but can actually earn it. Who bids the least, gets to do it, and takes the prize?

name: Just Too Bored
summary: A web-drama depicting office romance that's full of mystery, secrets, and interns trying to navigate through work life.

name: Las tres caras de Eva
summary: A quiet woman suffers mysterious blackouts caused by two hidden alter-egos—a thrill-seeking rebel and a composed mediator. As her fractured mind threatens her marriage, a psychiatrist attempts to uncover her underlying trauma and fuse her personalities into one.

name: Allegedly with Ellison Barber
summary: Hosted weekly by journalist Ellison Barber, this gripping podcast digs into the most captivating and talked about true crime cases.

name: Godslayer
summary: On the monster-ravaged continent of Yuanyang, Lu Yuanqing, a young man, awakens the power of the Turbid Dragon after his sister is chosen as a Holy Maiden and turned into a porcelain statue. Determined to save her, he makes himself the most perilous cargo of all and joins forces with the Redtail Armed Escort Agency on a deadly journey across the monster wastes. But the deeper he ventures, the darker the truth becomes: behind Heaven's Blessing lies a brutal system of servitude, upheld by the Heavenwrights and the gods they serve. His quest to save his sister sets him on a path to slay gods, rewrite fate, and forge a new order.

name: Stand Up for Love
summary: Jiang Lai donated her kidney for the man she loved, only to be betrayed by him and framed as being mentally unstable in a deadly plot to silence her. After narrowly surviving, she takes on a new face and a new identity as Zhao Ke. Joining forces with the mysterious Zhao Mai, she sets her revenge plan in motion, turning the tables on those who wronged her. Amid a tangled web of love, hatred, and hidden secrets, Jiang Lai uncovers the truth buried in the past and finally claims the justice she deserves.

name: Farm Busily in the Cold Palace
summary: Modern office worker Lu Yunluo wakes up to find herself transported into the body of an abandoned consort banished to the cold palace, where she crosses paths with the newly crowned Emperor Ji Wujue. Hoping to live a quiet, carefree life, she uses her modern knowledge of medicine and farming to make a fortune and gradually earns the favor of the imperial court. Along the way, she unexpectedly finds love.

name: Filter
summary: Matty is an introverted boy who, despite his indecisive and hesitant nature, has managed to come out. He is surrounded by family and friends who support him. But when he falls in love with Radek, a boy his own age,he is harshly confronted with the reality of his first emotional confusions, mistakes, and failures. Suddenly, he must face unexpected problems and a lack of understanding from those around him. Will he manage to find a fragile inner balance amid the storm of a complicated adolescence?

name: Знахарь
summary: A young promising doctor, a happy husband and a darling of fortune, Razin loses everything in an instant. He is accused of murder, which he did not commit, and goes to jail. Even there, he remains true to his profession.

name: High School Boy
summary: Daemun Boys' High School is notorious for bringing together troubled students from across the country. Small and physically vulnerable, Hong Il-tak becomes a constant target of bullying within the all-boys school's rigid social hierarchy. Determined to change his situation, he deliberately approaches Lee Hyun-woo, one of the most influential and popular students on campus. As misunderstandings and ambiguous encounters draw them closer, tension and attraction quietly begin to build. But as their feelings intensify, so do the jealousy, rumors, and pressure surrounding them.

name: Dom de Iludir
summary: Amid the glamour and privilege of Rio de Janeiro's elite, art collector Lúcia Rossetti and her daughter, Maíra Rossetti, are caught in a complex and turbulent relationship. When their lives intersect with Irina, a web of secrets, tensions and mysteries begins to unfold.

name: Wisdom of the Crowd
summary: John Bishop hosts as players take on the audience to win up to £30,000. The science says the audience should win. But will anyone manage to steal it by beating the wisdom of the crowd?

name: Die Putzfrau
summary: While working as a temporary cleaner, Teri witnesses a murder. To save her own life, she offers to clean up the crime scene for the hotel manager. This lays the foundation for a dangerous pact: Teri needs money for expensive but vital therapy for her daughter Luca. So from then on, she cleans up crime scenes for the wealthy Vincent. With each job, the former medical student finds herself in a deeper moral conflict. The state criminal investigation department quickly picks up her trail.

name: Africa: Earth's Wild Home
summary: Africa: Earth's Wild Home captures four years of unprecedented wildlife encounters across nearly 30 countries, revealing Africa's breathtaking landscapes alongside the frontline conservationists fighting to preserve the continent's wild future.

name: Thunder Chaser
summary: As drug trafficking spreads unchecked, narcotics squad captain Bai Hua leads young police officers, including Zhuang Yan and Li Xiao, into perilous missions. They work undercover and pit their wits against drug dealers. Step by step, they unravel the trafficking network, ultimately arrest the kingpin, tear out the corrupt protective umbrella behind him, and keep the border safe.

name: The Masked Lover
summary: Warlord Lu Zhentian controls Fancheng. His adjutant, He Jingchen, plots to seize the Lu family's hidden treasure, hoping to strengthen the army and protect the people. Su Yutang, an orphan from an opera troupe, goes undercover to seek revenge. After uncovering He Jingchen's plan, she turns it to her own advantage, throwing the situation into turmoil. When they discover that Lu Zhentian plans to trade the treasure for opium and harm the people, Su Yutang and He Jingchen see through each other's facades and join forces. Together, they lay a trap, seize the treasure, and ultimately set off on a new journey side by side.

name: Doctor at Sea
summary: Doctors Duncan Waring and Dick Stuart-Clark leave St. Swithin's behind and take to the high seas as ship's physicians aboard a Mediterranean cruise ship, where their new surroundings bring a fresh assortment of medical mishaps, troublesome passengers and comic adventures.

previousepisode.name: But It's So Much Nicer to Come Home

name: Doctor at Large
summary: Doctor at Large is a British television comedy series based on a set of books by Richard Gordon about the misadventures of a group of newly qualified doctors. The series follows directly from its predecessor Doctor in the House, and was produced by London Weekend Television in 1971.

name: Urban Horror
summary: Do you often feel inexplicably disturbed in this cold, unconcerned city? Those things we are used to but not specifically noticed are not caused by supernatural or spiritual phenomena but the daily, under-the-surface crises sparked by the fear, ignorance and indifference around us. This is a series without ghosts, monsters, supernatural or sci-fi components.

name: Geordie Coppers
summary: New series following Newcastle's neighbourhood police teams and their partners as they tackle crime, disorder and the many unexpected challenges of keeping one of Britain's liveliest cities safe.

name: Paul, la série
summary: At nearly 30, Paul Mirabel has just sold Amazon the recording of his show and a documentary about his life. Problem, he spent more time on his PlayStation than working and has no archival footage. In short, he lied. How far will this bluff take him? And to top it off, a childhood love resurfaces, because problems never come alone…

name: Glory Days
summary: Glory Days follows a tight-knit group of four high school friends—Walker, Dave, Dominic, and Trigg—as they navigate their early careers and struggle to maintain their friendships into adulthood.

name: Kanata Kara
summary: A captivating cast of characters embarks on a rich adventure and destiny, weaving a love story that will bring you to tears. Furthermore, the science fiction elements remain compelling even in today's world.

name: Family Full House
summary: Hosted by Indian cricket icon Rohit Sharma, two families go head-to-head in a high-stakes, laughter-filled gameshow featuring relatable trivia, nostalgic household challenges, and playful family rivalries.

name: Ντέρτι
summary: Stella returns to 1987 Patras to face her mother Xenia, a legendary nightclub singer who abandoned her at age five. Their reunion dredges up buried secrets, forcing both women to reckon with absence and the slow path toward forgiveness.

name: Dusty Bluffs
summary: When the editor of the "Dusty Bluffs Gazette" skips town, lifelong paperboys MP and Jer refuse to give up the only job they've ever wanted. With overconfidence and zero qualifications, the boys take the reins of a newspaper they've never read.

name: Garo: Higashi no Kairo
summary: A Japanese live-action tokusatsu television drama set in the Ryūga-verse continuity. Taking place after the events of "Heir to Steel Armor", the story centers on the collapse of the Eastern Region following a catastrophic desertification event caused by the Horror Garzas, and the defense of the region by the Golden Knight Ryuga Dougai.

name: Revenge From A Wife
summary: Chen Shou He, a craftsman who weaves with grass, incurs the wrath of Consort Chen over a piece of "Twinroot Grass" and is brutally tortured to death. His wife, Su Wan Niang, eagerly awaits his return, only to receive his corpse stuffed with withered grass. Devastated by grief, she assumes the identity of Su Cao, a female physician, and infiltrates the imperial city. Using a herbal medicine stall as her cover, she quietly builds an intelligence network and carefully plots her way closer to the emperor, one step at a time. She has only one goal: to avenge her murdered husband.

name: She Lies in Wait
summary:
She Lies in Wait seamlessly blends the past and present day, as we're introduced to seven teenagers, Topaz, Aurora, Callum, Benners, Jojo, Coralie and Brett, who go camping in Brinken Wood, part of the New Forest in July 2002. Only six teenagers emerge from the trip as 15-year-old Aurora mysteriously vanishes with no trace, instigating an exhaustive police investigation with public appeals by her family.  

Flipping deftly between the timelines, the surviving teenagers, including Aurora's sister Topaz, are now in their early 40s and successful in their careers.  But what secrets do they harbour?  They all claim to be innocent, but someone must surely be lying?  Will the secrets of what happened that fateful night ever be known?

name: Help Me Tiny Big Brain
summary: Each episode sees three junior geniuses (the Tiny Big Brains) paired with three different comics who try their best not to scupper the Tiny Big Brains' chances of victory!

name: Naked and Afraid: Aadimanav
summary: Discover how six survivalist dropped in the Filipino wilderness naked face harsh terrain, scarce resources, and constant exposure. Survival depends on endurance, resilience, adaptability, and smart decisions.

name: Bébés Lemmings
summary: For the Baby Lemmings, the world is a playground—and there's nothing better than sharing this philosophy of life with anyone in the Canadian forest who needs it. When you look at life the Lemming way, you can overcome any challenge—and have fun doing it!

name: Best and Bester
summary: Best and Bester is an animated buddy comedy following a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

name: Love Island VIPS
summary: A group of singles is once again going in search of love, and given the VIPS format, we will see some familiar faces returning.

name: Locatie Onbekend
summary: In Location Unknown, we travel to the most inaccessible places in the world. Which team will be the first to reach the finish line within 48 hours?

name: Good Luck Guys: Overleven zonder filter
summary: In this program, an unexpected group of heroes embark on the adventure of a lifetime. Surviving on a deserted beach on the other side of the world. They all have some form of fame, but once on the beach that no longer matters and they have to rely on themselves. Completely outside their comfort zone, the personalities normally accustomed to luxury compete in duos.

name: Great Ghost Tales
summary: This live television anthology series presents weekly, standalone adaptations of classic supernatural and gothic horror stories by authors like Edgar Allan Poe and W. W. Jacobs. Introduced by an off-screen narrator, each episode plunges everyday characters into unsettling encounters with the paranormal, featuring ominous doppelgängers, cursed artifacts, and psychological dread. Performed entirely in real-time, the show relies on atmospheric suspense and stagecraft to explore fate, guilt, and terror.

previousepisode.name: Who's the Fairest One of All?

name: Dark Machine: the Animation
summary: In a near-future Japan dominated by the hit e-sport Dark Machine, Kairi enters the high-stakes city of Golden Valley following his late grandfather's plea to "Find Senki"—the title held by top player Ajima. After rescuing the hunted Rudra, Kairi enters the arena, unleashing hidden talents on his rise to the top.

name: Magic Knight Rayearth
summary: Hikaru, Umi, and Fuu, girls from separate schools, find themselves linked together as they fall through the floor during a field trip to the Tokyo Tower. They land in a place called Cephiro, where their will controls what happens. They meet with Guru Clef and find out that they were summoned to save Princess Emeraude who has been imprisoned by High Priest Zagato. They learn magic and acquire weapons on their quest to save Cephiro from the evils of Zagato.

name: Romelia War Chronicle
summary: After journeying alongside her fiancé on his quest to defeat the Demon King, Romelia is suddenly deemed useless and sent home, her engagement annulled. While the prince and his group return as celebrated heroes, Rome goes home as a disgrace. But she's not the same girl who left her province. While following the adventurers, Rome was the only one without magic or strength but she found her own abilities in trade, negotiation, finances, and gathering information. And now, she plans to use these skills to not only help her family's province, but help the still struggling kingdom. The Demon King may be defeated, but his allies and demons continue to roam. With only her wits and brilliance, Rome will build an army of her own and keep the kingdom safe—no matter what it takes.

name: Outside
summary: With no Wi-Fi, beds or roof over their heads, will these influencers rough it to win whatever's left of £1 million — or burn cash on overpriced comforts?

name: So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin?
summary: Office worker Akira Yagami's altruistic nature usually gets him the short end of the stick. When he dies after saving a kid from oncoming traffic...he reincarnates in another world as a goblin?! Normally, goblins only live for seven days, but Akira's newfound powers let him defy the species' normal life span... and are the key to his path to becoming the strongest goblin ever!

name: Hunting Gary Glitter
summary: A string of dogged journalists chases fugitive pop star Gary Glitter across the globe — from Cuba to Cambodia to Vietnam — determined to expose the child sexual abuse he concealed behind decades of chart-topping fame. This documentary follows their pursuit alongside the survivors who speak out, charting Glitter's 1997 conviction, through to his years on the run, and eventual incarceration.

name: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life
summary:
Rein, an enchanter who strengthens equipment with his magic, is suddenly expelled from his guild, simply because every piece of gear in the guild has already been enhanced enough. Outraged by the absurd treatment, Rein decides to take back the enormous amount of mana he had poured into their equipment. When he casually channels it into a random copper sword, it transforms into a cheat-level weapon with 10,000 enhancement points!

With zero combat experience but armed with magic that can turn anything into overpowered gear, this enchanter sets off to enjoy a new, carefree life as an adventurer!
